code: #' DisplayString #' A class for displaying strings #' @importFrom checkmate assertCharacter assertVector #' @export DisplayString <- R6::R6Class(   "DisplayString",   inherit = DisplayTerm,   active = list(     #' @field contents A vector of replacement strings     contents = \(value) {       if(missing(value)) {         return(private$.contents)       }       if(!is.vector(value)) {         value <- c(value)       }       checkmate::assertVector(value, min.len = 0, names = "unnamed")       checkmate::assertCharacter(value)       private$.contents <- value     }   ),   public = list(     #' @description Initialize a new `DisplayString` object     #' @param contents The contents of the `DisplayString`     #' @param separators How many separators to use between the contents     #' @param trailing_mode If the contents should be trailed by the separtors     #' @param separator The separating characters (typically `\\n`)     #' @return A new `DisplayString` object     initialize = \(contents, separators = 0,                    trailing_mode = FALSE, separator = "\n") {       if(missing(contents)) {         contents <- character()       }       super$initialize(contents = contents,                        separators = separators,                        trailing_mode = trailing_mode,                        separator = separator)     },     #' @description Generates the string to insert     #' @returns The display text     makeText = \() {       body <- paste(self$contents, collapse = self$getSeparators())       return(self$trailing(body))     },     #' @description Adds a terms terms to the contents     #' @param terms A character or a vector of character objects     addTerms = \(terms) {       #' Adds a terms terms to the contents       if(!is.vector(terms)) {         terms <- c(terms)       }       checkmate::assertVector(value, min.len = 1, names = "unnamed")       checkmate::assertCharacter(value)       self$contents <- c(private$.contents, terms)       return(invisible(self))     }   ) ) ex_c <- DisplayString$new(   contents = c("Line 1", "Line 2", "Line 3"),   separators = "2",   trailing_mode = FALSE,   separator = "\n") ex_text <- ex_c$makeText() ex_n <- DisplayNone$new() ex_n <- DisplayTerms$new(contents = list(ex_c, ex_n)) ex_h <- DisplayHeader$new(   header = "Cool Header",   level = 2,   contents = ex_n,   link = "cool_file.md")
